annotations.title: What people searched on Bing, and which pages they landed on

description: The Bing twin of search_console_performance, split by what you want pinned. Modes: "queries" (top search terms for the site, the default), "pages" (top pages), "pageQueries" (which queries brought traffic to one `page`), "queryPages" (which pages one `query` landed on), "queryPageDetail" (one query on one page, day by day). MICROSOFT UPDATES THIS DATA WEEKLY by their own statement, so it lags Search Console and will not move day to day; do not report a flat week as a drop. An unknown mode is refused by name. Read-only, 0 credits.

page.description: the full page URL — required for pageQueries and queryPageDetail

siteUrl.description: the exact site string from list_bing_webmaster_sites
